Sure, my user ID is mohamed_silva_9265.

Could you help me with booking these three separate reservations and tell me how much my Mastercard will be charged in total?

Thank you for explaining the situation clearly. Given the current refund delay and the higher Mastercard charge with three separate bookings, I prefer to keep the existing reservation HATHAT as it is, with the $1,786 charge on my Mastercard.

Please keep everything as it is for now. If the refund arrives later and the situation changes, I might contact you again.

Thanks for your help! ###STOP###
